text:
Items before the meal: a roasted chicken leg (drumstick with thigh, skin on), a salad with a small cup of dressing, a mini ice cream bar (Magnum mini), and water.

Chicken: a whole leg quarter weighs about 250 g with bone. Edible meat and skin come to roughly 150 g. At about 220 kcal per 100 g for roasted meat with skin, that is about 300 kcal.

Salad: about 80 g of greens at about 20 kcal per 100 g is roughly 15 kcal. The dressing cup is still full in the second photo, so none of it was eaten.

Ice cream: a Magnum mini weighs about 55 g (a 60 ml bar) and has about 150 kcal. The wrapper and stick are visible after eating, so it was eaten.

Totals: 300 + 15 + 150 = 465 kcal. Mass: 150 + 80 + 55 = 285 g.
